ten: Docker va Kubernetes tu co ban den thuc chien
mo_ta: Hoc cach dong goi ung dung bang Docker va dieu phoi cum container bang Kubernetes qua cac bai lab thuc te.

ten: Nhap mon Docker cho nguoi moi
mo_ta: Khoa hoc ngan gioi thieu container va Docker compose cho lap trinh vien chua tung dung container.
Xay dung pipeline tich hop va trien khai lien tuc tu dong bang GitHub Actions cho du an thuc te.

ten: Terraform va Infrastructure as Code tren AWS
mo_ta: Quan ly ha tang dam may bang ma nguon voi Terraform tren nen tang Amazon Web Services.
Nam cac dich vu cot loi cua AWS gom EC2 S3 va Lambda cho nguoi moi buoc vao dam may.

ten: Kubernetes nang cao va van hanh production
mo_ta: Van hanh cum Kubernetes o moi truong production kem giam sat bang Prometheus va Grafana.
Xu ly du lieu lon bang Python ket hop truy van SQL toi uu cho pipeline du lieu.
Khoa hoc nhap mon ngon ngu Python tu bien kieu du lieu den ham va lap trinh huong doi tuong.

ten: DevOps toan dien Docker Kubernetes CI/CD Terraform
mo_ta: Lo trinh DevOps day du tu container hoa dieu phoi cum pipeline tu dong den quan ly ha tang bang ma.

ten: Machine Learning co ban voi Python
mo_ta: Cac thuat toan hoc may nen tang gom hoi quy phan loai va danh gia mo hinh bang Python.

ten: Git va quan ly ma nguon hieu qua
mo_ta: Thanh thao Git tu commit nhanh branch den giai quyet xung dot khi lam viec nhom.
Quan tri may chu Linux gom phan quyen tien trinh mang va giam sat tai nguyen he thong.

ten: Xay dung REST API voi FastAPI
mo_ta: Thiet ke va trien khai REST API hieu nang cao bang FastAPI kem kiem thu tu dong.

ten: Giam sat he thong voi Prometheus va Grafana
mo_ta: Thu thap chi so dung dashboard va cau hinh canh bao cho he thong phan tan.
